end

	return part(parent, name, cf * rot, V(length, dia, dia), color, o)

## Problem
Playtest anomaly (broken_link, medium, system pathfinding): Pathfinding returns NoPath in the lobby and walks stop short of targets
Expected: Pathfinding finds routes in the lobby, so bots and testers can reach the Mission Board and other targets.
Observed: Round 1's judge reported NoPath results in the lobby and walks ending short of their targets. This may be why the tester never triggered the Mission Board prompt.

-- Insert in StationBuilder.Build after the MissionBoard model and its "BoardPrompt" exist.
-- `board` is the MissionBoard Model, `O` is the origin CFrame, `model` is the station model.
-- Gives the board a real anchored base at floor level, moves the prompt onto it,
-- and adds a floor-level approach point 5 studs in front of the board.
local function anchorMissionBoard(board: Model, parent: Instance)
	local pivot = board:GetPivot()
	local base = Instance.new("Part")
	base.Name = "BoardBase"
	base.Anchored = true
	base.CanCollide = true
	base.CanQuery = true
	base.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
	base.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 106, 110)
	base.Size = Vector3.new(8, 1, 1.5)
	base.CFrame = CFrame.new(pivot.Position.X, 1.1, pivot.Position.Z) * (pivot - pivot.Position)
	base.Parent = board

	local prompt = board:FindFirstChild("BoardPrompt", true)
	if prompt and prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
		prompt.Parent = base
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = math.max(prompt.MaxActivationDistance, 12)
	end

	-- Floor-level approach point for bots and testers: 5 studs in front of the board (street side).
	local approach = Instance.new("Part")
	approach.Name = "BoardApproach"
	approach.Anchored = true
	approach.CanCollide = false
	approach.CanQuery = false
	approach.CanTouch = false
	approach.Transparency = 1
	approach.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.2, 2)
	approach.CFrame = base.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -5) -- board front faces -Z locally
	approach.Position = Vector3.new(approach.Position.X, 1.0, approach.Position.Z)
	approach:SetAttribute("Purpose", "MissionBoardApproach")
	approach.Parent = parent
end
